videoGap.mechanism: The exact 1.8.1 ClippingSampleStream readData method returns permanent EOS at the first out-of-range presentation timestamp in decode order. The real input then contains three still-in-range B-frame packets. Its method reproduction produces 42 rather than 45 in-range video frames.

dependencyCompatibility.alignment: Production module, standalone encoders and complete resolved application runtime must all use 1.11.1. Published Media3 constraints align Expo playback too. No Gradle force rule is added.
dependencyCompatibility.adaptation: Android prebuild config plugin changes only getAllocator and shouldContinuePreloading interface signatures by adding PlayerId. The existing method bodies, allocator and decisions are byte-identical.
dependencyCompatibility.javaCounterfactual: The original Expo class fails against the actual 1.11.1 interface with three compile errors; the adapted class compiles.
dependencyCompatibility.warnings: Existing deprecated Media3 API usage remains and compiles; the Java-only probe emitted missing optional annotation metadata warnings.
dependencyCompatibility.limits: These are real Java/Kotlin API compilations using official Android/Media3 artifacts. They do not replace Gradle dependency resolution, complete Expo application compilation, on-device playback or encoding acceptance.

decoderCorrections.orientation: Validate square pixels, a single exact orthogonal right-angle display matrix, and an actual unscaled FFmpeg PNG decode of 720 by 1280. Reject ambiguity, unsupported angles, scaling, shear, mirroring, translation and mismatched decoded size.
decoderCorrections.sourceAudio: Measure each output channel independently against the mono source fixture. Default stereo-to-mono normalization was inflating the correlated tone measurement.
decoderCorrections.baselineRecheck: Geometry and both equivalent audio channels pass; the actual 133.333 ms gap still fails. The original failed movie is not relabeled as accepted.

titleAutomation.sourceSemantics: Actual controlled TextInput onChangeText state and creative save callback preserve exactly the supplied value. There is no onBlur formatter. Pinned Maestro eraseText sends deletion at the current selection without selecting the full field.
titleAutomation.reproduction: A controlled mid-string deletion reproduces the exact ENTURES suffix; the failed run did not retain its actual caret, so this is a source-supported harness correction rather than a measured caret-state claim.
titleAutomation.repair: Use documented semantic longPress/Select All, erase one selected range, enter the intended title, read actual field text via copyTextFrom and require exact equality before Save. Keep the persisted/reopened cover assertion.
titleAutomation.runtimeSelectionAcceptance: Required in the next audit/full-native run.
